_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for sg13cmos5l-closed-loop-startup on the `klt sim` harness (issue #337, Part of #322).
The per-experiment half of the adapter contract: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py owns the record MECHANICS and takes
every piece of ARGUMENT from this file. Narrative is carried over from the legacy run_pvt_sweep.sh record text; it is not a new claim.
Infrastructure/plumbing evidence for issue #65's port, NOT a claim against any ratified spec row (spec/ tracks no ratified SG13CMOS5L accuracy target).
Claim: co-simulating SG13CMOS5L's bandgap_core + bandgap_amp + bandgap_startup (design/sg13cmos5l/, issues #64/#68) in one netlist (design/sg13cmos5l/bandgap_top.sch's own wiring: core.fb <- amp.out, core.sns1 -> amp.in_n, core.sns2 -> amp.in_p, startup shares sns1 and fb with the core), with vdd itself ramped 0 -> VDD over 200 us, the assembled block self-starts and settles to a closed-loop operating point across the full temperature x supply x pnpMPA/MOS/resistor-process-corner PVT grid: the startup circuit fully releases (v(det) <= 0.2*vdd, |i(XMKFB)| <= 50 nA), the real error amplifier closes the loop (|sns1-sns2| <= 20 mV), and fb settles to a real interior equilibrium rather than railing (fb within [0.05 V, vdd-0.05 V]). The three criteria are applied per point by sim/harness/cmos5l_klt.py (same constants and formula as sim/lib/pvt_verdict_common.sh pvt_closed_loop_verdict, 3-criteria form). Closed-loop infrastructure/plumbing evidence, NOT a claim against any spec accuracy/PSRR/Iq target.
Devices: All real PDK compact models, three DUTs copied verbatim from design/sg13cmos5l/netlist/bandgap_core.spice (three pnpMPA legs, three sg13_hv_pmos mirror legs, two rppd), bandgap_amp.spice (five sg13_hv_pmos, four sg13_hv_nmos) and bandgap_startup.spice (rhigh pull-up, two sg13_hv_nmos switches). No fixture stands in for the servo loop.
Netlist provenance: design/sg13cmos5l/netlist/{bandgap_core,bandgap_amp,bandgap_startup}.spice, device-for-device, wired as design/sg13cmos5l/bandgap_top.sch specifies, plus the Vmkfb ammeter. XMSENSE's width is read from the live bandgap_startup.spice by run_klt_sim.sh at run time and recorded in the msense_w column.
PDK: `ihp-sg13cmos5l` -- the TARGET/SETUP pin in sim/pdk-sg13cmos5l.json (IHP-Open-PDK dev subtree, sibling `ihp-sg13g2/` required). No record has yet been generated on that pin, so runtime compatibility is UNVERIFIED until the first one exists; a record minted from this spec must be read against the pin its run actually resolved (report `environment`), not against this sentence. OSDI models: sim/pdk-sg13cmos5l.json "osdi_toolchain".
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points) with pnpMPA x MOS-hv x resistor sections paired per sim/harness/cmos5l_klt.py CORNER_SECTIONS
